de935c38786265e7.title: PeakTracker.from_dict's non-finite window_factor reset is unpinned: with it off a restored 'nan'/'inf' factor discards the open window and its 2 kW peak, and the full gate stays green

de935c38786265e7.consequence: a persisted non-finite factor makes the line-465 domain check restart the window empty: the restored window's consumption never reaches the month's peaks, under-stating the billed peak that the optimizer plans against

4ad3dc13bfdb70a8.title: PeakTracker.from_dict's 0.0 <= window_factor bound is unpinned at 0.0: a legitimately persisted factor-0 (masked-month) window is restarted empty with a warning, and the full gate stays green

4ad3dc13bfdb70a8.consequence: the restored masked window is dropped and a misleading 'outside what the tracker writes' warning logged after every restart in a masked month; the closed peaks are unchanged (f0_peaks equal both arms) because a factor-0 window bills nothing

7fcaf91cced5ce41.title: PeakTracker.observe's non-finite/negative sample guard is unpinned: with it off a nan sample makes the month's peak nan and a negative one lowers it 2.0 -> 0.5 kW, and the full gate stays green

2d64a114647f1551.title: _smooth_topk_sum's np.any(x > 0) guard is unpinned at zero: a series of zeros and negatives returns a small negative sum (-4.9e-11) instead of 0.0, and the full gate stays green

5371ee2b5e897750.title: _smooth_topk_sum's no-positive-entry guard is unpinned: with it off an all-negative series returns -1.0 and a nan-only series nan instead of 0.0, and the full gate stays green

5371ee2b5e897750.consequence: the production caller passes non-negative excesses, where only the all-zero case is reachable and it is equal both arms; a negative or nan entry reaching it (a future caller, or a nan excess) would make the capacity charge negative or nan
